sections.title: The letter sound
paragraphs: The letter is called (пэ) /pɛ/. Its main sound appears in (папа) /ˈpa.pə/, which means dad, papa. This letter makes three sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Close both lips firmly to stop the air. Then open your lips quickly to let the air burst out. Keep your voice off. For the second sound, lift the middle of your tongue toward the roof. Release your lips cleanly. For the third sound, close your lips and turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: Before hard vowels, consonants, or at the end of a word, it sounds like (папа) /ˈpa.pə/. Before soft vowels or a soft sign, it sounds like (песня) /ˈpʲe.sʲnʲə/. A sound change happens before voiced sounds. There, the letter changes into the sound heard in (сбербанк) /zbʲɪrˈbank/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: You may blow out too much air. In spin, the lips release gently without a strong puff. Do not make the sound aspirated. A sound followed by a small puff of air, like p in pin, is wrong here. Hold the air back and release your lips cleanly.
